It's only in the demo for now. The tutorial: one match, called by the booth, from your first card to your first natural twelve. events.title: The demo trailer is here. Free demo October 10.
events.summary: The Cup is a free 1v1 creature card battler, and it launches on Steam on Tuesday, November 10! Every contestant is a mutated version of a real North American animal, entered under its true natural history. Field a survivor and a line of three, play cards, roll the dice printed on them, and hold the center. Two booth hosts call every swing of an alien broadcast. At launch: Steam multiplayer: live 1v1 against real people. THE ROAD, draft, and House matches against the AI. More bouts and more cards
